---
title: "Tablas EIRD vs Gini - ingreso, vivienda y salud"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(readxl)
library(ineq)
library(DepthProc)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(dplyr)

archivo <- "ECAF2019_analisis_variables_v3.xlsx"

vars_num <- c("ingreso_pc", "aporte_rel_edad", "act_fisica_min",
              "viv_servicios", "educacion", "satisf_salud")
vars_cat <- c("sit_ocupacional", "tipo_ocupacion", "salud_autoperc", "tenencia")
vars_all <- c(vars_num, vars_cat)
```

# Datos (jefes, caso_completo = 1)

```{r datos}
datos_todos <- read_excel(archivo, sheet = "Base_jefes_cod") %>%
  filter(caso_completo == 1) %>%
  filter(is.na(act_fisica_min) | act_fisica_min <= 4200) %>%
  mutate(pais = factor(pais))

datos_todos %>% count(pais)
```

# Índices univariados

```{r indices}
prune_uni <- function(data, lower, upper) {
  if (lower == 0 && upper == 0) return(data)
  lower_bound <- if (lower > 0) quantile(data, lower) else min(data) / 2
  upper_bound <- if (upper > 0) quantile(data, upper) else 2 * max(data)
  data[data > lower_bound & data < upper_bound]
}

gini_pruned_uni <- function(data, lower, upper) {
  ineq(prune_uni(data, lower, upper), type = "Gini")
}

robust_index_pruned_uni <- function(data, lower, upper) {
  data_pruned <- prune_uni(data, lower, upper)
  datos_mat <- matrix(data_pruned, ncol = 1)

  prof <- depthProjection(datos_mat, datos_mat)
  prof_estan <- prof / sum(prof)
  prof_mat <- prof_estan %*% t(prof_estan)
  dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist(data_pruned))

  sum(dist_mat * prof_mat) / (2 * abs(median(data_pruned) + 1))
}

paises <- levels(datos_todos$pais)

matriz_pais_variable <- function(indice) {
  sapply(vars_all, function(v) {
    sapply(paises, function(p) {
      x <- datos_todos %>% filter(pais == p) %>% pull(.data[[v]])
      indice(as.numeric(x), 0, 0)
    })
  })
}

mat_gini    <- round(matriz_pais_variable(gini_pruned_uni), 3)
mat_robusto <- round(matriz_pais_variable(robust_index_pruned_uni), 3)
```

# Correlación Gini vs EIRD (valores y rankings)

```{r correlaciones}
correlaciones <- sapply(vars_all, function(v) {
  g <- mat_gini[, v]
  r <- mat_robusto[, v]
  ok <- is.finite(g) & is.finite(r)
  c(
    corr_valores  = cor(g[ok], r[ok], method = "pearson"),
    corr_rankings = cor(g[ok], r[ok], method = "spearman"),
    n_paises      = sum(ok)
  )
})

t(round(correlaciones, 3))
```

# Tablas por variable

```{r funcion_tabla}
analisis_tabla <- function(v, alto = 95, ancho = 170) {

  idx <- tibble(pais = rownames(mat_robusto),
                EIRD = mat_robusto[, v],
                Gini = mat_gini[, v]) %>%
    filter(is.finite(EIRD), is.finite(Gini)) %>%
    mutate(rank_EIRD = rank(EIRD, ties.method = "first"),
           rank_Gini = rank(Gini, ties.method = "first"),
           dif_orden = rank_Gini - rank_EIRD) %>%
    arrange(EIRD)

  carpeta <- normalizePath("plots_tmp", mustWork = FALSE)
  dir.create(carpeta, showWarnings = FALSE)

  guardar_png <- function(grafico, prefijo, p) {
    archivo_png <- file.path(carpeta, sprintf("%s_%s_%s.png", prefijo, v, p))
    ggsave(archivo_png, grafico, width = ancho / 72, height = alto / 72, dpi = 72)
    archivo_png
  }

  hacer_plots <- function(p) {
    x <- datos_todos %>% filter(pais == p, is.finite(.data[[v]])) %>% pull(.data[[v]])
    dfp <- data.frame(x = x)

    gb <- ggplot(dfp, aes(y = x)) +
      geom_boxplot(fill = "tomato2", alpha = 0.6, outlier.size = 0.4) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
      theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

    gh <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = x)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "tomato2", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
      theme(axis.title = element_blank())

    tibble(boxplot    = guardar_png(gb, "box", p),
           histograma = guardar_png(gh, "hist", p))
  }

  idx <- bind_cols(idx, map_dfr(idx$pais, hacer_plots))

  idx %>%
    dplyr::select(pais, boxplot, histograma, EIRD, Gini, rank_EIRD, rank_Gini, dif_orden) %>%
    gt() %>%
    gt_img_rows(columns = boxplot,    img_source = "local", height = alto) %>%
    gt_img_rows(columns = histograma, img_source = "local", height = alto) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(EIRD, Gini), decimals = 3) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = "#F8D7DA"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(columns = c(rank_EIRD, rank_Gini, dif_orden),
                             rows = dif_orden != 0)
    ) %>%
    cols_label(pais = "País", boxplot = "Boxplot", histograma = "Histograma",
               rank_EIRD = "R. EIRD", rank_Gini = "R. Gini", dif_orden = "Δ") %>%
    cols_width(pais ~ px(80),
               c(EIRD, Gini, rank_EIRD, rank_Gini, dif_orden) ~ px(80)) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center",
               columns = c(EIRD, Gini, rank_EIRD, rank_Gini, dif_orden)) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(17), data_row.padding = px(2),
                table.width = px(850), table.margin.left = px(10),
                table.margin.right = px(10)) %>%
    tab_header(title = paste0("Distribución e índices por país — ", v))
}
```

## Ingreso per cápita

```{r tabla_ingreso}
t_ingreso <- analisis_tabla("ingreso_pc")
t_ingreso
```

## Índice de vivienda y servicios

```{r tabla_vivienda}
t_vivienda <- analisis_tabla("viv_servicios")
t_vivienda
```

## Satisfacción con la salud

```{r tabla_salud}
t_salud <- analisis_tabla("satisf_salud")
t_salud
```

# Exportar (HTML y PNG)

Para el PNG hace falta `webshot2` (`install.packages("webshot2")`).

```{r exportar, eval=TRUE}
tablas <- list(tabla_ingreso = t_ingreso, tabla_vivienda = t_vivienda, tabla_salud = t_salud)

for (nombre in names(tablas)) {
  gtsave(tablas[[nombre]], paste0(nombre, ".html"))
}
for (nombre in names(tablas)) {
  gtsave(tablas[[nombre]], paste0(nombre, ".png"), vwidth = 1000)
}
```
